attBesluta.text: Geiles Teil und macht echt was her. Es gab ein paar Komplikationen beim Zusammenbau aber Support hat gut geholfen. Immer wieder gerne

Mein erster Eindruck ist mega! Der Greifer wirkt sehr hochwertig, robust und sauber verarbeitet. Genau das, was ich für die Vermietung gesucht habe. Wenn er sich im Einsatz genauso bewährt wie der erste Eindruck vermuten lässt, bin ich absolut zufrieden.

Ein toller Kundenservice. Sie kamen mir sehr entgegen. Ich hatte am Anfang ein Problem mit dem Gerät, welches gut eingeordnet wurde und man kam mir vom Service entgegen. Mittlerweile kann ich damit leben. Also Vevor ist super! Das Gerät ist auch super und macht sehr viel Freude zu benutzen. Und Vevor hat mir weiterhin angeboten auf einzelne Teile falls etwas sein sollte mich melden zu dürfen.
Amazing product! Extremely easy to put together and very good quality! Recommended!
Super:) einfacher Aufbau. Sehr stabil. Robustes Material mit guter Verarbeitung!

Held off on getting one for the longest time, but as soon as my 11mo started being mobile, I knew it was time to hav a safe place for him to play without me worrying about what he’s getting in to. The quality is great and it’s so easy to assemble. The entryway zipper glides easily and only opens from the outside so no need to worry about your baby making an escape. The area itself is very spacious and large enough to house several toys and still have space to move around. My husband and I get in there and still have room! The material is easy to clean and doesn’t stain very much. Great buy for a great price.

Parc qui convient parfaitement aux enfants bien sécurisé et assez grand. Les ventouses aux pieds ajoutent aussi une sécurité supplémentaire en évitant au parc de bouger. Juste un détail si vous êtes petits comme moi (1m44) passez au dessus du rebord du parc pourrait s'avérer compliqué

Ottimo recinto gioco! Con qualche piccolo accorgimento relativamente al telo si può anche montare A METÀ, nel caso abbiate bisogno di maggiore flessibilità e non possiate permettervi di averlo sempre a occupare il massimo della superficie.

Our son uses this everyday and loves it! I would recommend getting a foam pad that fits inside of it like we did. It was very easy to erect and take apart! It is a nice size and fits multiple play stations!
Took a chance on it and it paid off. The action feels responsive under the fingers. Good quality at a fair price.
Helps my son with his coordination. He's learning to read music while playing, which is a bonus.
Doesn't feel like a toy—has a professional vibe. Can be used in small bands too.
Exactly what I needed for my music students. Sound is good, build quality is solid.
Really happy with this purchase. Easy enough for a beginner to pick up. Glad I went with this.

Onlangs dit klokkenspel aangeschaft, om thuis te kunnen oefenen. Heel blij mee. Mooi instrument voor niet te duur. Fijn voor een beginneling als ik, dat er letters op staan;) En ik vind er een mooi geluid uit komen. Ook een handieg hoes, makkelijk mee te nemen
Work's perfectly, nice sound, complete package, 2 different sets of sticks, soft bag with handle, the Lyra/xilofone folds in half. maches price tag, fast shipping
My son uses this for his percussion class… it’s good quality. No problems.
Tardo en llegar más de lo que esperaba, paro me llegó y estoy encantado, pues era para regalar y hacer que comience en el mundo de la música. Fantástico regalo para mi nieto, le encantó
Ottimo prodotto. Facile da montare, ottima acustica.

Glockenspiel très intéressant pour les débutants. Le son est clair, les notes sont repérées avec des lettres pour que l'enfant s'y retrouve. En tous cas mon fil de 9 ans l'adore et il pourra d'autant plus le garder un petit moment! Petit point négatif: il n'y a pas d'attache pour accrocher le support " défilé ". Mais tout le monde ne défilé pas, c'est la raison pour laquelle j'ai mis les 5 étoiles
This is an excellent instrument for the price. My daughter played this during the Christmas program at church and it was beautiful.

Absolutely awesome, better than I could’ve hoped for the price! Daughter with autism & ADHD has now made sure all in the house (and perhaps neighbours) are deaf but we descended to that eventuality with loud and lovely song 🎶

The tuning of the glock is really good, I was surprised totally. The practice pad is not the best, but it is totally usable. The sticks are also just toys, but still usable. The thread on the glock (om the bottom) is bad, so I have to recut it (with a Vevor thread cutter?, hehe) I think it is a perfect gift for kids starting and music school. Do not buy smaller than the 32 note version. Oh, and the Bag is brilliant. Btw I'm a professional percussionist, teaching in the school and playin' in the opera.
This is a good starter kif for my son that is starting band this year, just wish the sticks were a little better quality.
Took a chance on it and it paid off. The keys have a nice weight to them. The sound is warm and pleasant to play. Shipping was quick and well protected. A solid choice I would buy again.
produit de bonne qualité, mon fils l'utilise pour son apprentissage de percussions
Für diesen Preis unschlagbar! Überraschend guter Klang! Danke für das Angebot!
Good quality, sound and a lot of fun when you play.
This is perfect for my seventh grader to practice on at home.
